Definition: from a compound of G1909 and σφάλλω (to trip); figuratively, insecure:--dangerous.
BiblicalUsage: Episphales means dangerous, insecure — and Paul warns that sailing was now dangerous, because the fast was already past, and Paul admonished them.
TheologicalSignificance: Paul saw the danger before the storm did, and the ship sailed anyway — to its cost, and the warning was wisdom, not fear.
